The [feedforward networks chapter](feedforward-networks.qmd) trained its [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) with full-batch [gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/optimization.html#def-gradient-descent),
and [lds's chapter on gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html) covers the algorithms that do better. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
This lecture runs them in PyTorch on the digits:

1.  training on small random subsets of the training images instead of all of them at each step;
2.  momentum and [Adam](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-adam) as PyTorch optimizers;
3.  changing the [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) during training,
    starting with a short ramp up;
4.  choosing the scale of the starting weights.
